text: Men Arsiki Ibraahiima ɓiɗɗo wi'eteeɗo Ishaaqa e taaniraawo wi'eteeɗo Yaaquuba, Men Fewni ɓe ɗiɗo kala e laawol focciingol. Men Fewni Nuuhu ado maɓɓe, Men Fewni e jurriiya Nuuhu on Daawuuda e ɓiɗɗo makko on Sulaymaana, e Ayyuuba e Yuusufa e Muusa e neene-gooto makko on Haaruuna (yo ɓe his). Ko wano Men Yoɓitiri nii ɓee Annbaaɓe e moƴƴere maɓɓe nden, Men Yoɓitirta kala moƴƴinooɓe.
